name: Honda XL250 / XL350
engine: 248 or 339 cc air-cooled single, carb, points ignition on early bikes
intro: Honda's early dual-sport singles. Points ignition on the first ones, six-volt on some, and old wiring everywhere.

H: Air-cooled Honda singles need the valve clearance checked often. A tight exhaust valve is the usual cause of hard starting.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
